title: Build identity visible to sessions: engram --version and the next receipt carry the runtime build fingerprint
outcome: Build identity visible to sessions: engram --version and the next receipt carry the runtime build fingerprint
acceptance: engram --version prints the package version plus the runtime-derived build fingerprint; next (CLI and MCP) carries the same fingerprint once per receipt so a session can tell its MCP child is stale after an install; no build.rs, no git plumbing; complements the doctor build_fingerprint item

completion.summary: Delivered runtime-derived process/schema identity on version and CLI/MCP next, lazy for short-lived CLI diagnostics and captured at MCP startup, with bounded receipts and explicit unavailable values. Validated by all required gates and two-reviewer code closure.
